docs.snippet: /** 1.2: emit a `raise` node for `panic!()` (throw) / `return Err(…)` (isErrReturn) + a `raises`

action.expr: const id = this.ctx.idFor('raise', { file: this.path, line });

const node: Node = {
      id,
      kind: 'raise',
      name,
      file: this.path,
      span: { start: line, end: line },
      lang: 'rust',
      hash: this.ctx.hash(`${this.path}:${line}:raise:${name}`),
      ...(s.errorMessage ? { errorMessage: s.errorMessage } : {}),
      ...exprFields(s.text),
      meta: { inLoop, inException, ...(last ? { branch: last.branch } : {}) },
    };

this.edges.push({
      id: edgeId(procId, id, 'raises'),
      src: procId,
      dst: id,
      rel: 'raises',
      method: 'static',
      provenance: 'EXTRACTED',
      confidence: 1,
      evidence: { by: 'rust-extractor', snippet: name },
      cfgPath,
      ...(last ? { guard: last.condId, branch: last.branch } : {}),
      inLoop,
      inException,
    });
